questions.question: Who invented the World Wide Web and created the original HTML specification in 1991?
options: Tim Berners-Lee
Brendan Eich
Alan Turing
Håkon Wium Lie
questions.hint: Think of the British scientist at CERN who founded the W3C.
questions.explanation: Tim Berners-Lee invented the World Wide Web and developed HTML at CERN in 1991.

questions.question: What does the acronym HTML stand for?
options: HyperText Markup Language
High-level Text Management Language
Hyperlink and Text Making Layout
Home Tool Markup Language
questions.hint: It combines HyperText with Markup Language.
questions.explanation: HTML stands for HyperText Markup Language, the standard markup language for documents designed to be displayed in a web browser.

questions.question: Which role in web development is specifically assigned to HTML?
options: Defining visual styles, animations, and responsive colors
Providing the structural skeleton and semantic content
Handling client-side algorithmic calculations and API calls
Executing database queries on backend cloud servers
questions.hint: Think of structure vs styling vs scripting.
questions.explanation: HTML defines the structure and meaning of web content. CSS handles styling, and JavaScript handles dynamic behavior.

questions.question: What happens when a browser parses HTML code sent by a web server?
options: It compiles the code into machine binary assembly code
It constructs the Document Object Model (DOM) tree in memory
It uploads the file back to the domain name registrar
It automatically converts all tags into pure CSS properties
questions.hint: Look for the tree representation of document nodes.
questions.explanation: The browser's layout engine parses the HTML tags into the DOM (Document Object Model) tree to render the page visually.

questions.question: What is the primary function of the HTTP protocol in the web ecosystem?
options: To compress image files before disk storage
To define rules for transferring data between clients and servers
To validate HTML syntax against the W3C specification
To encrypt operating system memory registers
questions.explanation: HTTP (Hypertext Transfer Protocol) is the request-response protocol used to transmit web pages, images, and API data over the internet.
